name.ja: NPC記憶とプロンプト重複の計測

description.en: Measures what the game itself remembers per NPC (memory / life_log / relationship / knowledge), how those fields enter conversation prompts, and how much of each prompt is duplicated - including the blocks injected by 311_npc_profile_memory
description.ja: ゲーム自身が NPC ごとに覚えるもの（memory・life_log・relationship・knowledge）の実体と、それが会話プロンプトへどう載るか、そして 311_npc_profile_memory の注入分も含めてプロンプト内の重複量を測る
